subject: Renewal QBR: Proposal for compact demo + slot exchange
messages:
From: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@sagehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@sagehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + roadmap demo — compact option request

Hi Grace and Marissa,

Thanks again for the renewal runbook you shared last week. Our execs have asked if we can compress the QBR demo into a tighter window — they want a focused 45-minute roadmap + hands-on highlight instead of the full 90. We know that means juggling other customers; we wanted to surface two constraints on our side:

- Amit and I are only available the week of Nov 3, preferably AM Pacific.
- We need a session that includes a short deep dive into latency/cost controls and the rollout policies you mentioned.

If you can propose a compact option that still hits those points, we can make a faster decision and accelerate procurement. We can be flexible on attendees (execs vs. engineering) depending on the slot.

Happy to jump on a quick call — but if a slot swap with another customer helps, we can accept a different day within that week.

Attaching our internal pre-read (agenda will be helpful).

Thanks,
Sarah
Director of Product
Sage Health

Attachment: sage-qbr-pre-read.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@sagehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — compact option request

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear constraints and the pre-read. Appreciate the preference for an AM Pacific week of Nov 3.

Two practical options from our side that will preserve the content you requested while keeping the session compact:

Option A (Priority): 45-minute condensed runthrough
- 12:00–12:45 PT (45m)
- 20min roadmap + 15min focused demo (latency/cost controls + rollout example) + 10min Q&A
- Requires: Exec + 1 eng lead from Sage for the deep dive

Option B (Swap/Compact): 60-minute window that we can secure by swapping a slot on Nov 4 with another prospect
- 10:30–11:30 PT (60m)
- 25min roadmap + 25min demo walkthrough (include runbook) + 10min Q&A
- We’ll bring a runbook spreadsheet and a short ops checklist.

If you pick Option B we’ll initiate a slot exchange and confirm the swap by EOD Mon (we’ll surface the affected customer and document the fallback). If you pick Option A we can reserve a compact slot in our limited AM pool (first-come-first-served).

I’m cc'ing Rishi (renewals) and Soojin (ops) so they can review procurement implications and the runbook attachments. I’ll also attach a compact agenda and a runbook draft for clarity.

Proposed next step: Reply with A or B + attendee list; we’ll take care of logistics.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr-compact-agenda-v2.pdf (application/pdf); runbook-demo-fallback.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@sagehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — compact option request

Quick calendar note from ops side — we can do Option B (60m swap) but two things to flag: 

1) Slot swap process: we will only swap with an external prospect if they accept our published alternate times; expected turnaround for the swap confirmation is 24–36 hours. If Sage needs hard confirmation today, Option A is safer.

2) Procurement handoff: If you go with the swap (Option B) and want us to file a canary procurement exception (to move billing window earlier), we’ll need a single procurement contact and PO intent by Nov 5. Rishi — can you confirm the quick procurement template?

Sarah — can you confirm who will attend from Sage (exec + eng lead or only execs)? That affects the content we prioritize. Also flagging that we’ll record and provide the runbook snapshot immediately after the session.

Thanks,
Marissa
Renewal Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@sagehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah O'Neill <sarah.oneill@sagehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — compact option request

Hi everyone — apologies for the short thread. Sarah and I discussed and we prefer Option B (60-minute swap) if Redwood can secure Nov 4 at 10:30–11:30 PT. Attendees: me (eng lead) + Sarah (product exec). We can provide PO intent by Nov 5; procurement contact is: Amit Rao <amit.rao@sagehealth.com> (cc'd).

Please confirm slot swap and DocuSign path; happy to take the runbook snapshot after the session for internal sharing.

— Amit
VP Engineering
Sage Health
